div.div: مَشْعُوفٌ [Burned in the heart by love: (see 1:) or] diseased [therein]: (AZ, S:) or struck, or smitten, in the شَعَفَة of his heart by love, or by fright, or by insanity, or madness. (O, K.) Insane, or mad. (O, K.) Bereft of his heart. (TA.) [See also مَشْغُوفٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
